description: Open a new work order (it starts as an estimate) for a customer and vehicle. Add services in the Shopmonkey UI. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/order.

customerId.description: The customer the order is for.

dueDate.description: When the vehicle is promised, ISO 8601 date-time.

locationId.description: The shop location id (see shopmonkey_get_current_user for the key's own location).

serviceWriterId.description: User id of the service writer.

workflowStatusId.description: Workflow status (board column) id — see shopmonkey_list_workflow_statuses.

name: shopmonkey_create_order
title: Create an order
